title: peaceful hunger v1.21.5
body:
Peaceful Hunger v1.21.5 brings back natural hunger restoration while playing on Peaceful difficulty, letting you enjoy a calmer Minecraft experience without losing the need to eat. Food once again has a purpose, making survival feel more grounded and immersive even without hostile mobs.

Perfect for players who want a peaceful world without completely removing the survival aspect, this mod restores hunger mechanics in a simple, clean, and lore-friendly way. Whether you are building, exploring, farming, or just enjoying a more relaxed style of play, you will still need to keep yourself fed.

Features:

Restores hunger functionality on Peaceful difficulty
Makes food useful again in Peaceful mode
Keeps gameplay simple, immersive, and survival-focused
Great for builders, explorers, and relaxed survival players
